name: be-legal-data
title: Belgian legal reference data
description: Courts, prisons, houses of justice, judicial areas, arrondissements and cantons, municipalities, and the legal and commercial interest rates of Belgium, with their official sources.

resources.name: judicial-areas
resources.title: Judicial areas
resources.description: The 5 areas of the courts of appeal (rechtsgebieden).

resources.name: arrondissements
resources.title: Judicial arrondissements
resources.description: The 12 judicial arrondissements and their judicial area.

resources.name: cantons
resources.title: Judicial cantons
resources.description: All 162 judicial cantons: name, seat, the municipalities they cover and the legal description of their area. Generated by scripts/build-cantons.ts.

sources.title: Judicial Code, annex art. 1 (numac 1967101058), Dutch and French

resources.name: municipalities
resources.title: Municipalities
resources.description: The 565 municipalities with their Statbel REFNIS code and province. Generated by scripts/build-cantons.ts.

sources.title: Statbel, population by place of residence (TF_SOC_POP_STRUCT_2026)

resources.name: courts
resources.title: Courts
resources.description: Every court of the judiciary on the courts' portal: 162 justices of the peace, the police courts, courts of first instance, enterprise and labour courts, courts of appeal, labour courts of appeal and courts of assize, with their divisions; names as published, address, registries' contacts, opening hours and ECLI codes. Generated by scripts/parse from the weekly snapshots.

sources.title: Cours & Tribunaux / Hoven & Rechtbanken (College of Courts and Tribunals)
ECLI codes: published Belgian decisions (openjusticebe/ecli) and e-justice.europa.eu
Cantons each court covers: Judicial Code, annex art. 3–5 and art. 114 (numac 1967101058)

resources.name: prisons
resources.title: Prisons
resources.description: The 39 prisons and detention houses of the FPS Justice, with their names in the three languages, address and contacts. Generated by scripts/parse from the weekly snapshots.

resources.name: houses-of-justice
resources.title: Houses of justice
resources.description: The houses of justice of the Flemish and French Communities, with address and contacts. The German-speaking Community's house in Eupen is not in the data yet. Generated by scripts/parse from the weekly snapshots.

resources.name: interest-rates
resources.title: Legal and commercial interest rates
resources.description: The legal interest rate (per calendar year, since 1970) and the rate for late payment in commercial transactions (per semester, since 2002).

sources.title: Belgisch Staatsblad: annual notice of the legal interest rate
